'''This gunship''' partook in the [[Battle of Onderon/Legends|Battle of Onderon]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and was one of the first of [[HMP droid gunship/Legends|HMP droid gunships]] to be used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]]. This droid gunship was ordered to take out the rebel resistance but after the arrival of [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] with [[Missile launcher/Legends|rocket launchers]], the [[Onderon Resistance|rebels]] were able to overpower all of the droid gunships and shoot them down. This gunship was shot down by [[Saw Gerrera/Legends|Saw Gerrera]] and it crash-landed into the cliff side where Saw's [[Steela Gerrera/Legends|sister]] and [[King/Legends|King]] [[Ramsis Dendup/Legends|Ramsis Dendup]] were. Unknown to the group, this gunship was still operational and while [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] attempted to lift Steela to safety with the force, the gunship fired its weapons, injuring Ahsoka and causing her to drop Steela to her [[Death/Legends|death]]. [[Lux Bonteri/Legends|Lux Bonteri]] managed to shoot the [[Turret/Legends|turret]] of the gunship and fully disabled the craft before it could harm anyone else.
